lines.en: The snow creaks under my paws.

lines.zh: 我扛着这一身厚皮往前走。
lines.en: I carry this thick hide forward.

lines.zh: 四五步就要停下来嗅一嗅。
lines.en: Four or five steps, then I sniff.
I follow the snowline.
This frame is heavier than it looks.
Each step leaves a deep pit.

lines.zh: 在雪原上没人比我更自在。
lines.en: No one's more at home on snow.
I circle around from upwind.
Ice crusts on my back.
I push the snowdrift aside.
My shoulders roll as I walk.
The wind's strong up here. I walk anyway.
I stand; snow gathers on my back.
My breath comes out in thick clouds.
I lick ice off my claws.
That scent was left recently.

lines.zh: 雪底下的声音，我比你先听到。
lines.en: I hear what moves beneath the snow before you do.

lines.zh: 肩膀上的旧伤又有点酸。
lines.en: The old wound in my shoulder aches.
I lift my head. Wind from the north.
It's suspiciously quiet here.
I sink my claws into the snow.
I'm not ready to move yet.

lines.zh: 你哈出的白气，散得太快了。
lines.en: The white puffs you breathe scatter too fast.
You're shaking badly. Cold?

lines.zh: 我看你的高度，像看一顿饭。
lines.en: I gauge your height like a meal.

lines.zh: 你手里那根棍子太细了。
lines.en: That stick of yours is too thin.
You stand out in the snow.
No rush. I'll wait for you to move.

lines.zh: 你背后的坡很高，跳不下去。
lines.en: The slope behind you is too high to jump.
Don't move when I raise a paw.
I remember that kind of scent.
Your breathing just quickened.
Thick hide, but that stung.
Half a step back. Making room.
Steam rises from the wound.
You found a thin spot.
I growl, and the snow shivers.
That only made me want to fight.
Another mark on the shoulder.

lines.zh: 雪被我的血烫出几个洞。
lines.en: My blood burns little holes in the snow.

lines.zh: 这点伤，只够我换个姿势。
lines.en: A wound like that just makes me shift stance.
Still standing. That's enough.
Is that meat in your hand?

lines.zh: 我守了一冬，肚子是空的。
lines.en: I've kept watch all winter on an empty belly.
Bring it closer so I can be sure.
I may not eat it, but come closer.
The meat's too lean; two sniffs and I leave.
You look nervous feeding me.
Throw it. Don't reach out.

lines.zh: 这味道像是从营地来的。
lines.en: This smells like it came from a camp.
If you're tricking me, I'll know.
Higher, so I can see it clearly.
Bump me and it's like hitting a tree.
I don't give way, and you can't push.
Your shoulder hit my ribs.

lines.zh: 我这身皮很厚，你没感觉吧。
lines.en: This hide is thick. Did you feel it?
You backed three steps and broke the snow.
We're both covered in snow.
Standing this close is dangerous.
You're bracing your shield against me.

lines.zh: 这道雪坡太窄，站不下两个。
lines.en: This slope is too narrow for both.
I nudged you aside.
This happens out on the snowfield.

lines.zh: 两只这么大的，动静不小。
lines.en: Two this big make quite a noise.
The ice on my back melted.
Don't stand downwind.

lines.zh: 我们不用打，只是靠一靠。
lines.en: We won't fight. Just lean together.
Its fur is whiter than mine.
Afterwards it heads north.
A body this size makes it hard work.

lines.zh: 地上被我们压出一块空地。
lines.en: We pressed a clearing into the snow.
When we part, both of us are panting.
I pick up a chunk of ice.
It was buried under snow half a day.
I dig it out with my paw.
The meat has frozen hard.
There's still meat on the bone.
I don't need it, but I'll take it.
Carrying it makes walking awkward.
I bury it under the snow.
I'll take all of this.

lines.zh: 捡起来的时候爪子会响。
lines.en: My claws click when I pick things up.
You walked onto my slope.
I've smelled you for a while.
This whole snowfield has only you.
I don't run. I charge.
You raised your weapon first.
Careful of the claws; they sweep.

lines.zh: 你站在雪坑边上，不好躲。
lines.en: You're at the pit's edge. Bad footing.
I come down from above, fast.
There are no trees to circle here.

lines.zh: 目标就是你，别的人不在。
lines.en: You're the target. Nobody else is here.

lines.zh: 刚才那一下，是我的警告。
lines.en: That was a warning.
You backed to the slope. Perfect.
The wind favors me.
No hurry. Snow slows everyone.
That armor won't stop the claws.
I'm treating this as a hunt.

lines.zh: 你的脚印陷得深，我顺着追。
lines.en: Your prints sink deep; I follow them down.
Your prints in the snow are obvious.
I'm on the high ground waiting.
On the ice you'll slip.
Can you hear my breathing?
The saplings block me; I smash straight through.
I circle around the snowdrift.

lines.zh: 你往冰上躲，我绕到冰前。
lines.en: You hide on the ice; I circle around ahead.
There's a scent behind this rock.

lines.zh: 你停在雪脊上，我停在下风。
lines.en: You halt on the ridge; I halt downwind.

lines.zh: 我把爪子松开，爪尖朝前。
lines.en: I unsheathe my claws, points forward.
A few steps more and I'll charge.
Your torch is nearly out.
The snow thickens. You'll get lost.

lines.zh: 我肩上的旧骨头咔了一下。
lines.en: The old bone in my shoulder clicks once.

lines.zh: 前面那道沟不深，我跨得过去。
lines.en: That gully is shallow. I'll step across.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地方，我都走过。
lines.en: I've walked everywhere you stepped.
I won't roar. Saving strength.
Your companions are heading elsewhere.
This road ends at a cliff.

lines.zh: 这一掌拍下来，雪都炸开。
lines.en: My paw comes down and the snow bursts.
The claws sweep upward.
I press you into the snow.
This can flip a horse.
You stopped the claw, not the bite.
Shoulder first, and you're airborne.

lines.zh: 我喘得很厉害，可还挺得住。
lines.en: I'm heaving, but still standing.
I drive my whole shoulder down.
Two claw marks on the ice.
You ducked behind the stone.
Blood on my claws. It's warm.
If you can still stand, again.

lines.zh: 这一下剖开了你的外套。
lines.en: That opened your coat.
I lunge and pin your leg.
We've trampled the snow to slush.
Don't shout. No one hears it here.
Low on blood, I got faster.
Claws and teeth together.
That one was pure rage.
You can't hold. Again.
I rise out of the snowbank.
Dropping from high up, I made a pit.
This snowfield is mine.
I shake the snow off my back.
Above the snowline, I open my eyes.
I walk slowly to the ridge.

lines.zh: 从上面看下来，什么都清楚。
lines.en: From up here everything's clear.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，白得很浓。
lines.en: My first breath came out thick and white.
My shadow on the snow is huge.
I crouched on the ridge all night.
You aren't the first to come up.
I'm on the summit. Take your time.
Fire singed my fur. It smells foul.

lines.zh: 雪坡太滑，我一路滚到坡底。
lines.en: The slope was slick; I rolled all the way down.

lines.zh: 冰水灌进毛里，沉得很快。
lines.en: Icy water soaks my fur; I sink fast.
The blast flipped me onto the snow.
An arrow in my shoulder blade. I can't shake it.
That light is colder than the snow.
Hungry, my charge has no force.

lines.zh: 雷落在雪原上，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning on the snowfield; I went numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地面可以踩。
lines.en: The void has no ground to stand on.
